violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED PLATES AND BOWLS RUN THROUGH DISHWASHING MACHINE AT ~10PPM.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: PLATES AND BOWLS RE-RUN THROUGH DISHWASHING MACHINE WHILE BEING PRIMED. FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES SANITIZED AT ~200PPM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE AT ~10PPM. MACHINE ONLY SANITIZES PROPERLY IF BEING PRIMED DURING SANITIZE CYCLE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE HAVE DISHWASHING MACHINE SERVICED. IT MAY NOT BE USED TO SANITIZE DISHES (UNLESS ACTIVELY BEING PRIMED), AND THE THREE-VAT SINK SHOULD BE UTILIZED TO PROPERLY SANITIZE DISHES. WHEN DISHWASHING MACHINE IS SERVICED, EHS RECOMMENDS ADJUSTING SANITIZER TO ~100PPM INSTEAD OF 50PPM CHLORINE. DENNY'S (Inspection Date: 10/31/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage 115F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED FOOD

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ham 47F, turkey 45F, cooked fajita vegetables 45F, prime rib 49F, sliced cheese 45-46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: EHS observed strawberries in the walk in cooler with a mold like substance on them.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. Pic segregated strawberries that were covered in a mold like substance and instructed staff to not use the strawberries. DENNY'S (Inspection Date: 11/13/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed pancake batter being stored on counter without an ice bath or written time as a public health control procedure.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC made a time label for the pancake batter

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed scoopers being stored in water baths that were not at 135F or running water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Pic turned on water baths to meet a temperature minimum 135F
